newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers move higher on cargo gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers move higher on cargo gains.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices moved higher as cargo demand started to pick up after the market's recent slow activities during holidays, traders said on Monday.

"Some sellers are quite conservative at the moment. They think prices may go up further," one trader said. The cargo market started a technical rebound late last week but some traders said prices went up too fast and were "not reasonable".
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $106-$107 per tonne and 180-cst at $113-$114, compared with $100-$103 and $107-$110 respectively last week. MDO was quoted at $210 and gas oil at $198.
